column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 25 (M23025): DEFY menyelamatkan konvoi; M16 muncul, target militer ternyata Doll Community.
# Tetap Inggris: Robella (RO), Leva, Lenna, Soppo, Kalina, Beluga, M16, Griffin,
# Griffin & Kryuger, Nyto/Nytos, Doll Community, Mokosh, Tomato King, Doll, Neural cloud.
# Catatan: tiga baris di file Inggris masih berbahasa Mandarin
# (dua bunyi efek dan 是的。= "Benar.") — diterjemahkan langsung ke Indonesia.
Cough, cough cough... honestly, I only planned to play around a little, but now I have no choice but to get serious...
column2: Uhuk, uhuk uhuk... sejujurnya aku cuma berniat main-main sedikit, tapi sekarang mau tidak mau aku harus serius...

column1: These combat Nytos, although mass-produced, are still much stronger than they were ten years ago...
column2: Nyto tempur ini, meski produksi massal, tetap jauh lebih kuat dibanding sepuluh tahun lalu...

column1: However, according to calculations, Kalina and the others should have already escaped the enemy's strike range...
column2: Tapi menurut perhitungan, Kalina dan yang lain seharusnya sudah lolos dari jangkauan serang musuh...

column1: Just... hold on a little longer, and we'll...
column2: Cukup... bertahan sebentar lagi, lalu kita...

column1: (The battle had raged on longer than expected, but the enemy forces before them were far more tenacious than anticipated.)
column2: (Pertempuran itu berkecamuk lebih lama dari perkiraan, dan pasukan musuh di depan mereka jauh lebih ulet dari dugaan.)

column1: (Robella evaluated the current situation... If they didn't want to violate their agreement with Kalina, they had to figure out a way to retreat right now.)
column2: (Robella menimbang keadaan saat itu... Kalau mereka tidak mau melanggar kesepakatan dengan Kalina, mereka harus mencari cara mundur sekarang juga.)

column1: (But just as the intent to evacuate began to form in their minds—)
column2: (Tapi tepat saat niat untuk menyingkir mulai terbentuk di benak mereka—)

column1: ("Boom," "Boom," "Boom"—)
column2: ("Buum," "Buum," "Buum"—)

column1: (Lenna, who was providing electronic support at the very rear, was suddenly blocked by a howitzer fired from afar.)
column2: (Lenna yang memberi dukungan elektronik di barisan paling belakang tiba-tiba terhadang tembakan howitzer dari kejauhan.)

column1: We were discovered after all! The enemy information we finally managed to locate...
column2: Ternyata kita ketahuan juga! Padahal informasi musuh itu susah payah kami dapatkan...

column1: Sister Leva, what should we do next?
column2: Kak Leva, kita harus apa selanjutnya?

column1: Just defeating these Nytos isn't enough, we have to find a way to deal with the troops behind them too—
column2: Mengalahkan Nyto ini saja tidak cukup, kita juga harus mencari cara menangani pasukan di belakang mereka—

column1: (Just as Leva was planning the next tactical plan, the armored vehicle that was originally serving as the military's short-range defense line on the front line suddenly slowly stopped.)
column2: (Tepat saat Leva menyusun rencana taktis berikutnya, kendaraan lapis baja yang semula jadi garis pertahanan jarak dekat militer di depan itu tiba-tiba berhenti perlahan.)

column1: Have the enemies... been beaten back by us?
column2: Apa musuhnya... sudah kita pukul mundur?

column1: No, this is—
column2: Bukan, ini—

column1: Everyone, be careful!!!
column2: Semuanya, hati-hati!!!
（"Swuush——"）

column1: (The bulky land mobile unit suddenly opened its rear cargo bay. Accompanied by the swirling dust, the sound of helicopter rotors was deafening in the empty desert.)
column2: (Unit bergerak darat yang bongsor itu tiba-tiba membuka palka kargo belakangnya. Diiringi debu yang berpusar, deru baling-baling helikopter memekakkan telinga di gurun yang kosong itu.)

column1: (After exhausting most of the Dolls' primary firepower, the military's follow-up forces, armed with ample firepower supplies, attempt to encircle them.)
column2: (Setelah menguras sebagian besar daya tembak utama para Doll, pasukan lanjutan militer yang berbekal amunisi melimpah berusaha mengepung mereka.)

column1: （“哒哒哒哒哒——”）
column2: （"Tak tak tak tak tak——"）

column1: (Dense autocannon shells rain down, exploding among the ranks of the Dolls.)
column2: (Peluru meriam otomatis yang rapat menghujan turun, meledak di tengah barisan para Doll.)

column1: (As a ground force completely devoid of anti-air measures, the appearance of helicopters is undoubtedly a fatal blow to them.)
column2: (Sebagai pasukan darat yang sama sekali tak punya sarana anti-udara, munculnya helikopter jelas pukulan mematikan bagi mereka.)

column1: ...How cunning! A situation like this practically makes it impossible to do anything!
column2: ...Licik sekali! Keadaan seperti ini praktis membuat kita tidak bisa berbuat apa-apa!

column1: Robella, help me out!
column2: Robella, bantu aku!

column1: Let me go... I'll take care of that guy in the sky!
column2: Lepaskan aku... aku yang akan mengurus yang di langit itu!

column1: What are you doing, Soppo!
column2: Kau mau apa, Soppo!

column1: Now is not the time to do this kind of thing!
column2: Sekarang bukan saatnya melakukan hal semacam itu!

column1: I promised Kalina that I would bring you back safely!
column2: Aku sudah berjanji pada Kalina akan membawamu pulang dengan selamat!

column1: So strange...
column2: Aneh sekali...

column1: What's wrong... Big Sis Leva?
column2: Ada apa... Kak Leva?

column1: Nothing, probably just an illusion...
column2: Tidak ada, mungkin cuma perasaanku saja...

column1: So you noticed it too, Leva.
column2: Jadi kau juga menyadarinya, Leva.

column1: Right.
column2: Benar.

column1: If it was just to intercept the supply line, why would they send so many combat units over at the same time...
column2: Kalau cuma untuk mencegat jalur pasokan, kenapa mereka mengirim begitu banyak unit tempur sekaligus...

column1: Could it be that their target isn't just—
column2: Jangan-jangan sasaran mereka bukan cuma—

column1: (BOOM!)
column2: (BUUM!)

column1: (The team communication was interrupted by a huge explosion. The missile fired by the helicopter exploded close to the ground, plunging everyone into silence for a moment.)
column2: (Komunikasi tim itu terputus oleh ledakan besar. Rudal yang ditembakkan helikopter meledak dekat permukaan tanah, membuat semua orang terdiam sesaat.)

column1: (Fortunately, as ground combat Dolls, their targets were too small for the airstrike to hit accurately, and they were only overturned to the ground by the fierce airflow caused by the explosion.)
column2: (Untungnya, sebagai Doll tempur darat, sasaran mereka terlalu kecil untuk dikenai serangan udara secara akurat, dan mereka hanya terjungkal ke tanah oleh embusan udara dahsyat akibat ledakan itu.)

column1: Cough cough... Soppo, Leva, Lenna!
column2: Uhuk uhuk... Soppo, Leva, Lenna!

column1: How are you—
column2: Bagaimana keadaan kalian—

column1: (The second missile struck again, blasting a huge crater in the sand.)
column2: (Rudal kedua kembali menghantam, meledakkan kawah besar di pasir.)

column1: (Then, immediately following was...)
column2: (Lalu, tepat menyusul setelahnya...)

column1: ("Whoosh—")
column2: ("Wuush—")

column1: ("Bang—!")
column2: ("Blam—!")

column1: (The helicopter was preparing to launch its third missile, but the fuselage snapped in half right at the moment the missile was about to leave the pylon.)
column2: (Helikopter itu bersiap meluncurkan rudal ketiganya, tapi badannya patah dua tepat saat rudalnya hendak lepas dari tiang gantung.)

column1: (It was hit by a laser cannon fired from nowhere, falling from the sky like a dragonfly with broken wings, and ignited a raging fire on the ground.)
column2: (Ia dihantam meriam laser entah dari mana, jatuh dari langit bagai capung patah sayap, dan menyulut kobaran api besar di tanah.)

column1: What's going on...
column2: Ada apa ini...

column1: (Before Robella had time to think, continuous sounds of giant artillery came from afar again, and in just an instant, swept the enemy's main armored troops clean.)
column2: (Sebelum Robella sempat berpikir, deru artileri raksasa kembali terdengar bertubi-tubi dari kejauhan, dan hanya dalam sekejap menyapu bersih pasukan lapis baja utama musuh.)

column1: (In the distance, after a fierce battle, peace was restored to this desert once again.)
column2: (Di kejauhan, setelah pertempuran sengit, ketenangan kembali menyelimuti gurun itu.)

column1: (Following that, several black silhouettes appeared.)
column2: (Setelah itu, beberapa siluet hitam muncul.)

column1: Oh my, look at these Griffin guys, what a disgrace♪
column2: Aduh, lihat orang-orang Griffin ini, memalukan sekali♪

column1: Tsk, if we weren't in a hurry, I'd really want to admire their pathetic state for a bit longer.
column2: Cih, kalau kita tidak sedang buru-buru, aku benar-benar ingin menikmati kondisi menyedihkan mereka lebih lama.

column1: It's you...
column2: Kalian...

column1: Hmph... the smell of ugly freaks.
column2: Hmph... bau makhluk aneh yang jelek.

column1: (The appearance of the mysterious troops made extreme displeasure appear on Soppo's face.)
column2: (Munculnya pasukan misterius itu memunculkan rasa tidak suka yang kentara di wajah Soppo.)

column1: You... why are you here?
column2: Kalian... kenapa ada di sini?

column1: (With the retreat of the military troops, the few people recovered one after another from the shock of the bombing. Seeing the Dolls in front of them, they all showed expressions similar to Robella's.)
column2: (Dengan mundurnya pasukan militer, beberapa orang itu satu per satu pulih dari guncangan pengeboman. Melihat para Doll di depan mereka, semuanya menunjukkan ekspresi serupa dengan Robella.)

column1: Who cares about them! Let me dismantle a few parts to use first—
column2: Siapa peduli mereka! Biar kupreteli beberapa suku cadangnya dulu buat dipakai—

column1: (Leva reached out and grabbed Soppo, who was eager to try and staring up and down at the opposite side.)
column2: (Leva mengulurkan tangan menahan Soppo yang sudah gatal ingin mencoba sambil melirik lawan dari atas ke bawah.)

column1: They don't have any spare parts for you to use this time, Soppo.
column2: Kali ini mereka tidak punya suku cadang yang bisa kaupakai, Soppo.

column1: I remember the last time we met, the number of parts on the two of you combined was already less than the armored vehicle that just drove away, right?
column2: Kalau tidak salah ingat, terakhir kali kita bertemu, jumlah suku cadang kalian berdua digabung pun sudah lebih sedikit daripada kendaraan lapis baja yang barusan pergi, kan?

column1: If I remember correctly, my former "friends"?
column2: Kalau ingatanku benar, "teman-teman" lamaku?

column1: You—
column2: Kau—

column1: Enough, don't forget we have other missions at hand.
column2: Cukup, jangan lupa kita punya misi lain yang harus dikerjakan.

column1: We will perfectly complete the mission of this trip.
column2: Kami akan menuntaskan misi perjalanan ini dengan sempurna.

column1: Also, please ask you and the people from 'Griffin & Kryuger' not to slack off too much on this battlefield, so as not to hold us back.
column2: Lagi pula, tolong minta kau dan orang-orang 'Griffin & Kryuger' jangan terlalu bermalas-malasan di medan tempur ini, supaya tidak menghambat kami.

column1: Yes, yes, you're always so strict. Be careful, keeping a straight face all day, the Commander might prefer the other head maid in the future, you know?
column2: Iya, iya, kau memang selalu galak. Hati-hati lho, kalau wajahmu datar terus seharian, nanti Komandan bisa lebih suka kepala pelayan yang satunya.

column1: ...A meaningless joke, let's go.
column2: ...Lelucon yang tidak bermakna, ayo pergi.

column1: (Leva stood quietly in place, waiting for them to leave.)
column2: (Leva berdiri diam di tempatnya, menunggu mereka pergi.)

column1: (Along with their departure, dense and regular sounds of mechanical friction came from all around.)
column2: (Bersamaan dengan kepergian mereka, bunyi gesekan mekanis yang rapat dan teratur terdengar dari segala arah.)

column1: (That was the sound of hundreds of mechanical creations starting up simultaneously and following closely behind to evacuate.)
column2: (Itu suara ratusan ciptaan mekanis yang menyala serentak lalu mengikuti rapat di belakang untuk menyingkir.)

column1: (This is also a matter of course.)
column2: (Dan itu memang sudah sewajarnya.)

column1: (This former nemesis was never a team that relied solely on individual abilities to play the hero on the battlefield.)
column2: (Musuh bebuyutan mereka yang dulu itu tidak pernah menjadi tim yang hanya mengandalkan kemampuan perorangan untuk berlagak pahlawan di medan tempur.)

column1: (Never was.)
column2: (Tidak pernah.)

column1: Suddenly appearing and suddenly disappearing...
column2: Muncul tiba-tiba lalu lenyap tiba-tiba...

column1: Is this playing out some kind of saving the princess drama?
column2: Ini sedang memainkan drama menyelamatkan sang putri, ya?

column1: Oh right, these guys are so weird... why would they come here?
column2: Oh iya, orang-orang ini aneh sekali... kenapa mereka datang ke sini?

column1: I knew it...
column2: Sudah kuduga...

column1: Huh?
column2: Hah?

column1: For example, if someone whose... "Neural cloud was accidentally covered by a virus, so they completely didn't explain to their comrades and could only leave the familiar team without authorization" suddenly appeared here, I wouldn't be surprised at all.
column2: Misalnya, kalau ada orang yang... "Neural cloud-nya tak sengaja tertutup virus, sehingga sama sekali tidak menjelaskan pada rekan-rekannya dan cuma bisa meninggalkan tim yang dia kenal tanpa izin" tiba-tiba muncul di sini, aku sama sekali tidak akan kaget.

column1: (Leva's gaze drifted to the white-haired Doll left behind by this unit, standing alone not far away.)
column2: (Pandangan Leva beralih ke Doll berambut putih yang ditinggalkan satuan itu, berdiri sendirian tak jauh dari sana.)

column1: Isn't that right, M16?
column2: Benar begitu, kan, M16?

column1: Wah—it really is you! Sis 16!!!
column2: Wah—ternyata benar kau! Kak 16!!!

column1: (Seeing Beluga's figure, Soppo immediately threw herself onto her.)
column2: (Melihat sosok Beluga, Soppo langsung menghambur memeluknya.)

column1: (However, Robella didn't show any surprise, but just slowly walked to her side.)
column2: (Namun Robella sama sekali tidak menunjukkan keterkejutan, hanya berjalan perlahan ke sisinya.)

column1: M16... you're finally willing to appear...
column2: M16... akhirnya kau mau muncul juga...

column1: Haha, sorry about that.
column2: Haha, maaf soal itu.

column1: If I had known it would be such a touching reunion scene, I should have prepared a few wine glasses in advance.
column2: Kalau tahu akan jadi adegan reuni seharu ini, mestinya aku menyiapkan beberapa gelas anggur dari tadi.

column1: (Beluga rubbed Soppo's head, her movements like she was picking off a little black dog that kept pouncing on her.)
column2: (Beluga mengusap kepala Soppo, gerakannya seperti sedang melepaskan anjing hitam kecil yang terus menerkamnya.)

column1: But it doesn't seem like a good time for a drink right now.
column2: Tapi sepertinya sekarang bukan waktu yang tepat untuk minum-minum.

column1: Is Kalina still safe?
column2: Kalina masih aman?

column1: Yes. Before the battle officially started, we had her take the supply convoy and relocate to a safe place.
column2: Ya. Sebelum pertempuran resmi dimulai, kami menyuruhnya membawa konvoi pasokan dan berpindah ke tempat aman.

column1: M16, did we take good care of Kalina?
column2: M16, kami menjaga Kalina dengan baik, kan?

column1: Yeah, Soppo has finally grown into a reliable adult, hahaha.
column2: Iya, Soppo akhirnya tumbuh jadi orang dewasa yang bisa diandalkan, hahaha.

column1: So, Soppo.
column2: Jadi, Soppo.

column1: You guys follow this route and take Kalina out of this area.
column2: Kalian ikuti rute ini dan bawa Kalina keluar dari kawasan ini.

column1: Ahhh? But—
column2: Haah? Tapi—

column1: But the Commander is still fighting inside Mokosh city, we have to transport the supplies there as soon as possible...
column2: Tapi Komandan masih bertempur di dalam kota Mokosh, kita harus mengantar pasokannya ke sana secepatnya...

column1: RO, I understand your concerns.
column2: RO, aku paham kekhawatiranmu.

column1: But during the combat just now, you should have noticed, right?
column2: Tapi selama pertempuran tadi, kau pasti sudah menyadarinya, kan?

column1: 是的。
column2: Benar.

column1: As expected, it wasn't an illusion.
column2: Ternyata memang bukan perasaanku saja.

column1: So the military troops we're facing this time aren't just here to intercept supplies, right?
column2: Jadi pasukan militer yang kita hadapi kali ini bukan sekadar untuk mencegat pasokan, kan?

column1: The Commander's battle on the Mokosh front line is indeed very difficult, but the enemy troops haven't gained much advantage either.
column2: Pertempuran Komandan di garis depan Mokosh memang sangat berat, tapi pasukan musuh juga belum mendapat banyak keuntungan.

column1: In order to prevent backup troops from arriving, they have other tactical targets that need to be struck.
column2: Untuk mencegah bala bantuan tiba, mereka punya sasaran taktis lain yang perlu dihantam.

column1: For example—
column2: Misalnya—

column1: So that's how it is... everything makes sense now.
column2: Jadi begitu... sekarang semuanya masuk akal.

column1: Why the radar started to completely fail as soon as it entered here, and... why they sent such a huge team to execute the interception mission.
column2: Kenapa radarnya langsung lumpuh total begitu masuk ke sini, dan... kenapa mereka mengirim tim sebesar itu untuk menjalankan misi pencegatan.

column1: It's too dangerous to go to where the Commander is right now...
column2: Terlalu berbahaya pergi ke tempat Komandan sekarang...

column1: Relying solely on this supply team, it's very difficult to reach the center of the battlefield without losses.
column2: Hanya mengandalkan tim pasokan ini, sangat sulit mencapai pusat medan tempur tanpa kehilangan.

column1: And going to the Doll Community to set up defenses in advance can not only relieve the pressure on the Mokosh front line, but also preserve a reliable retreat route for the Commander.
column2: Sedangkan pergi ke Doll Community untuk memasang pertahanan lebih awal bukan cuma meringankan tekanan di garis depan Mokosh, tapi juga menjaga jalur mundur yang bisa diandalkan untuk Komandan.

column1: ...You're right, 16.
column2: ...Kau benar, 16.

column1: Rather than risk forcing our way through the blockade, it's better to execute this safer plan.
column2: Daripada nekat menerobos blokade, lebih baik menjalankan rencana yang lebih aman ini.

column1: Not to mention...
column2: Belum lagi...

column1: Not to mention, it's also time to harvest Tomato King's farmlands.
column2: Belum lagi, ini juga saatnya memanen ladang Tomato King.

column1: (Everyone exchanged glances, tacitly agreeing on the feasibility of this plan.)
column2: (Semua orang saling bertukar pandang, tanpa kata menyepakati bahwa rencana itu layak dijalankan.)

column1: What if the Commander doesn't have our help...
column2: Bagaimana kalau Komandan tidak mendapat bantuan kita...

column1: There will be.
column2: Akan ada.

column1: ...Huh?
column2: ...Hah?

column1: (Robella seemed to have noticed something from Beluga's certain tone. She cast a probing glance at the other party, but the other party only responded with a smile.)
column2: (Robella seakan menangkap sesuatu dari nada yakin Beluga. Dia melempar tatapan menyelidik, tapi lawan bicaranya hanya membalas dengan senyum.)

column1: Yes—!
column2: Siap—!

column1: (Robella looked at Beluga, then at Soppo.)
column2: (Robella menatap Beluga, lalu menatap Soppo.)

column1: (She decided to save this surprise for last.)
column2: (Dia memutuskan menyimpan kejutan ini untuk yang terakhir.)
